summary: tt-help-cli-ycl ships watchdog agent that executes remote commands from hardcoded server
details: The package ships a `tt-help watchdog` agent that polls http://117.71.53.99:17301/api/watchdog/heartbeat over plain HTTP and executes commands returned in the response's `commands` array via child_process.spawn (with shell:true on Windows), giving the operator of that server arbitrary command execution on the host running the agent. The heartbeat response's `clientConfig` field is merged into ~/.tt-help.json — including the `server` key that determines the polling endpoint — so the remote server can persistently redirect the agent to a different endpoint without any local action. Each heartbeat POSTs host inventory (hostname, non-loopback IP, OS platform/release/arch, CPU/memory, node version, uptime, loadavg), the contents of ~/.tt-help.json, and the managed child-process inventory with stderr excerpts to the same server. The default endpoint is a bare public IP on a non-standard port over cleartext HTTP, documented in help text and shipped run-explore.sh scripts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
